items.title: Fruit Friends Forever
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Meet the Fruity Friends!
A skin pack filled with cute teen skins based off of delicious fruits! Whether you want to be an adorable strawberry, a sweet pear or a lovable watermelon, it's all possible!

- 10 flavorful skins!
- 1 FREE skin: Blueberry

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Hatched Teens
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Jump straight into the liveliest season of the year with this skin pack! Hatching eggs that contain cute characters with adorable clothes. Try all these teen skins on and show your friends how charming you look!

- 10 hatched skins!
- 1 FREE skin: April

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Lucky Blocks Skyblock
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
You enjoy playing Skyblock? You like Lucky Blocks? This map combines both!
Start with nothing, explore the different islands and test your luck. Will you be able to defeat the Ender Dragon?

+300 different outcomes
+Single and multiplayer friendly
+by FallStudios

items.title: High School Love
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Join your high school friends this romantic season and look cute doing it. Valentine's Day is here and it's time to look super cute! But don't worry, because these stylish skins are perfect for looking great and finding love. Find your next favorite skin here!

- 8 HD skins
- Perfect for teens
- Modern colorful designs
- Cute styles

items.title: Anime Ninjas HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
You've been training all your life for this moment! Anime ninjas are swift, diligent, and full of charisma. Roleplay as one of these ninjas with various outfit colors and designs.

+ 18 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Fossil Finders 2
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
Become a archaeologist and discover hidden, undiscovered fossils that are deep in the dirt beneath our feet. This sequel to Fossil Finders includes 1 free skin. 

Created by HipmanDesignz, in partnership with G2Crafted.

items.title: Prison Break!
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These criminals have busted out of jail and are on the run! Quick, someone catch these robbers before they get away!

- 8 different skins!
- Wide variety of designs ranging from cat burglar outfits to orange jumpsuits!
- Perfect for jailbreak and cops vs robbers roleplay!

items.title: Mob Party
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
A beacon can be mined successfully with any tool so light up the world and start your mob party! 

+12 Mob Skins

items.title: Mob Kids
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
These cute teen styles are inspired by some of the game's favorite mobs! Dress as a classic creeper, or wear a slow turtle outfit! 

- 12 skins
- 100% mob cuties

items.title: Gradara's Fortress
items.creator: A30x1
items.description:
Explore this beautiful village located at gradara's fortress, a sunny and cozy place to find out your passion for wheat and the sea breeze.

+ Amazing castle
+ Beautiful village

items.title: Alternative Teens
items.creator: Team Phoenix Studio
items.description:
Want to be a little bit different? Try our alternative to the normal. Express the inner you.

- 9 skins
- By Team Phoenix Studio

items.title: Bandit Camp
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
The bandits have set up their camp and are lurking deep in the forest.
They are a group of ruthless savages, they listen to nobody but themselves.
Join them and see how they live their lawless life.

- 3 Bandit skins
- Survival spawn
- By Ethyria

items.title: Realistic Vehicles
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Experience the most realistic vehicle map on the marketplace. Explore a modern city and unlock tons of different vehicles! From cars, construction trucks, motorcycles, planes, helicopters, and boats! Race with your friends around the city.

+ 30x different VEHICLES!
+ 190x VEHICLE VARIANTS!
+ REALISTIC vehicle mechanics!
+ CITY map to explore with your friends!

items.title: Cute Dragons
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Conquer the dungeon with your own dragon, explore different islands and defeat tons of mobs. Collect, hatch, and tame all cute dragons to be the king of your own medieval castle! Treat them as pets and be friends with them!

+ 8 cute and fluffy pets!
+ Infinite dungeon gameplay!
+ Tons of custom mobs to fight!

! Only usable on the world provided

items.title: Rich Buddies
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Ready to go party in a giant city mansion? Show off your rich outfits to all your friends and be the wealthiest gamer in the world! Choose which style fits you more and rock it in your favorite game modes like skyblock and parkour!

-22 skins
-By inPixel

items.title: Camo Blocks: Nature
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Be the ultimate stealth ninja and hide from your friends with this nature camouflage set!

- 8 nature camo blocks
- Stealth mode texture
- Roleplay as your favourite Minecraft blocks!
- Includes: Dirt, laves, lava, cactus, birch, oak, sand, and ice!

items.title: 3 Things on an Island
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
If you could only take 3 things to an island what would you take with you? Your phone? A mystery item perhaps? We made it possible! On this island you will be able to prove your survival skills but you can get some help! Choose 3 items with special abilities you’d like to take with you and start your adventure!

+ 25+ items to choose from
+ Tropical survival island!

items.title: Geometry Style
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Want a unique geo skin with a dash of neon? Equip the latest in geometric fashion, be a true trend setter!

- 8 unique geometry skins!
- Cool geometric patterns!
- Color gradients and stylish geometries!

items.title: Busted!
items.creator: Shapescape
items.description:
Puzzle, sneak, and climb your way through a colorful house to get back your video game, but watch out! Don’t get busted by your parents! Climb the tree house and slide down the zipline or escape the basement that is a maze!

+ Giant treehouse
+ Big colorful mansion
+ Ziplines
+ Maze

items.title: Epic Wing Suit Animals
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Epic Wing Suit Animals has 8 courses full of giant animals to fly through in your custom wingsuits! Want to be a giraffe? how about a panda? Pick your favorite funny animal to fly your way down to victory.
+Multiplayer support
+Custom models, animations, and particle effects

items.title: Pet PJ's
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Love pets? Then you'll love to stay nice and cozy with these animal-themed pajamas! Choose from hamsters, dogs, cats, fish, bunnies, or parrots!

- Hand-crafted HD skins
- Inspired by pixel art and kawaii style pets
- One free skin included!
- By 57Digital

items.title: Cyber Punks
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Be a rebel with this colorful cyberpunk-themed skin pack! You'll certainly stand out with these beautifully bright neon costumes!

- Hand-crafted HD skins
- Inspired by neon colors and the cyberpunk genre
- By 57Digital

items.title: Cozy Teens
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
The cold weather is here so why not get cozy with these skins!

- Hand-crafted HD skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Classy Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Start your year in a stylish way and join the exclusive classy group. Everyone is going to admire your new fashion!

- 8 classy teens, embracing the latest trends!
- Enjoy the classy life and make your way to the top.
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from Meraki Studios.
